title: Derived etale image retaining the restriction representative equation
statement: Let O be a commutative ring, t in O, j:X→Z a scheme morphism, I its ordinary coefficient-system image datum, and PZ,PX coefficient-evaluation packages [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces, def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data]. There is a full derived image datum D for I such that its restricted inverse-image comparison is represented by the ordinary I.restrictInverse comparison. Explicitly, for n≤m and every unbounded complex P at level n of Z, D.restrictedInverse(h) at Q(P), followed by restriction of the level-n inverse factorization and the X restriction factorization, equals the level-m derived inverse applied to the Z restriction factorization, followed by its inverse factorization at Res(P) and Q of I.restrictInverse(h) at P. Writing R_Z,R_X for ordinary coefficient restrictions, R_Z^D,R_X^D for their derived functors, f_n for the ordinary inverse image, F_n for its derived inverse, r for D.restrictedInverse(h), b for I.restrictInverse(h), p_n:Q F_n≅f_n Q for the inverse factorization and q_T:Q R_T^D≅R_T Q for restriction factorization (composition in Lean order), the identity is r(QP) followed by R_X^D(p_n(P)) and q_X(f_n P) equals F_m(q_Z(P)) followed by p_m(R_Z P) and Q(b(P)). All complexes are unbounded. In addition D has all the evaluation, scalar, adjunction, detection, boundedness and origin fields of the full derived image datum.

proof.text: Repeat the existing unbounded image assembly using termwise exact inverse images and K-injective right images. Construct the evaluation and restriction squares by localization of the ordinary squares. Retain the restriction square representative identity as an additional conclusion rather than discard it when packaging the scalar data. The tensor and direct-image mates, transition equations, and adapted flat resolutions are exactly those in coefficientSystemUnboundedComparison.

Assemble the full derived image datum. Evaluation detects isomorphisms as in coefficientSystemDerivedComparison. The exact derived adjunction bounds and cohomology detection give boundedness and the origin counit isomorphism. Scalar-adjunction descent gives normalization of the scalar transposes. The retained equation is unchanged because restrictedInverse in the package is the restriction square constructed in the first step.

lean.statement:
theorem strictEtaleImageWithRestriction_exists
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (t : O)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z)
    (I : StrictEtaleOrdinaryImage O t j)
    (PZ : StrictEtaleEvaluation Z O t) (PX : StrictEtaleEvaluation X O t)
    : ∃ D : CoefficientSystemDerivedImage (J := Z.smallEtaleTopology)
      (K := X.smallEtaleTopology) O t _ _ _ I PZ PX,
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (P : CochainComplex (strictEtaleLevel Z O t n) ℤ),
    (D.restrictedInverse h).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      (PX.scalar h).restriction.map ((D.level n).inverseFactors.hom.app P) ≫
      (PX.scalar h).restrictionFactors.hom.app
        ((((I.lift n).modules).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
    (D.level m).inverse.map ((PZ.scalar h).restrictionFactors.hom.app P) ≫
      (D.level m).inverseFactors.hom.app
        (((coefficientRestriction (J := Z.smallEtaleTopology) O t h).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (I.restrictInverse h) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
